title: Austin's Interim City Manager
summary:
*   A special executive meeting was held to address the city's administrative structure.
*   Council members appointed Mr. W. T. Williams, Jr. as the new Acting City Manager.
*   The Acting City Manager's annual salary was set at $12,500.
*   One council member cast a dissenting vote on the appointment, citing an already heavy workload.
